title: Capture permissions
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: Dense meme and sticker cutouts frame a white central onboarding area. A notification prompt overlays the permission explanation; later frames show a loading state and invite-code entry with the keyboard. The decorative border persists around changing functional content.
learning_candidate: A stable illustrated frame can give sequential forms a consistent identity.
